```{r setup,include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
# directory<-paste0(dirname(rstudioapi::getActiveDocumentContext()$path),"/")
directory <- paste0(getwd(), "/")
df_work        <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(paste0(directory, "cv_v1.xlsx"), sheet = "work")
df_education   <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(paste0(directory, "cv_v1.xlsx"), sheet = "education")
df_examples    <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(paste0(directory, "cv_v1.xlsx"), sheet = "examples")
df_details     <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(paste0(directory, "cv_v1.xlsx"), sheet = "details")
df_description <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(paste0(directory, "cv_v1.xlsx"), sheet = "description")
df_projects    <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(paste0(directory, "cv_v1.xlsx"), sheet = "projects")
```

  colframe=accent!25,

}

\begin{tcolorbox}[namebox, title={\LARGE Dimitrios Zacharatos\hfill\normalsize\mdseries Psychometrician \textperiodcentered\ Quantitative Researcher}]
```{r details,results='asis',echo=FALSE}
cat(paste0("\\small ", df_description$description[1], "\n\n\\vspace{4pt}\n"))
contacts <- character()
for (i in 1:nrow(df_details)) {
  icon <- sub("\\\\+$", "", df_details$icon[i])
  link <- df_details$link[i]
  label <- df_details$label[i]
  if (grepl("^(https?://|mailto:|tel:)", link)) label <- paste0("\\href{", link, "}{", label, "}")
  contacts <- c(contacts, paste0("\\textcolor{accent}{", icon, "}\\, ", label))
}
# three per row
cat("{\\small\\begin{tabularx}{\\linewidth}{@{}XXX@{}}\n")
rows <- split(contacts, ceiling(seq_along(contacts) / 3))
for (r in rows) cat(paste0("  ", paste(c(r, rep("", 3 - length(r))), collapse = " & "), "\\\\\n"))
cat("\\end{tabularx}}\n")
```
\end{tcolorbox}

\begin{tcolorbox}[sectionbox, title=Experience]
```{r work_experience,results='asis',echo=FALSE}
cat("\\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=0pt, label={}, itemsep=0.5em, topsep=0pt]\n")
for (i in 1:nrow(df_work)) {
  resp <- gsub("\\\\", " ", df_work[i, "responsibilities"], fixed = TRUE)
  cat("\\item\\begin{tabularx}{\\linewidth}{@{}p{2.9cm} X@{}}\n")
  cat(paste0("  \\textbf{\\textcolor{accent}{", df_work[i, "date_start"], "--",
             df_work[i, "date_finish"], "}} &\n"))
  cat(paste0("  \\textbf{", df_work[i, "company"], "} \\textbullet\\ ",
             df_work[i, "role"], " \\textit{\\small(", df_work[i, "status"], ")}\\\\\n"))
  cat(paste0("  & \\small ", resp, "\n"))
  cat("\\end{tabularx}\n")
}
cat("\\end{itemize}\n")
```
\end{tcolorbox}


\begin{tcolorbox}[sectionbox, title=Projects]
```{r projects,results='asis',echo=FALSE}
cat("\\begin{tabularx}{\\linewidth}{@{}p{2.9cm} X@{}}\n")
for (i in 1:nrow(df_projects)) {
  cat(paste0("  \\href{", df_projects$link[i], "}{\\textbf{\\textcolor{linkblue}{", df_projects$name[i], "}}} & \\small ",
             df_projects$description[i], "\\\\[2pt]\n"))
}
cat("\\end{tabularx}\n")
```
\end{tcolorbox}

\begin{tcolorbox}[sectionbox, title=Skills]
```{r skills,results='asis',echo=FALSE}
for (cat_name in unique(df_examples$Experience)) {
  cat(paste0("\\textbf{\\textcolor{accent}{", cat_name, "}}\\\\[4pt]\n"))
  cat("\\raggedright\n")
  rows <- df_examples[df_examples$Experience %in% cat_name, ]
  for (j in seq_len(nrow(rows))) {
    name <- rows$full_name[j]
    if (tolower(name) != tolower(rows$abbreviation[j])) name <- paste0(name, " (", rows$abbreviation[j], ")")
    cat(paste0("\\skillchip{\\href{", rows$link[j], "}{\\textcolor{linkblue}{", name, "}}} \\hspace{2pt}\n"))
  }
  cat("\n\\vspace{8pt}\n\n")
}
```
\end{tcolorbox}
